events.title: Voyager 2 launch
events.detail: Launched first, on a slower path that let it visit all four giant planets.

events.title: Voyager 1 launch
events.detail: Launched second on a faster path; it overtakes Voyager 2 before Jupiter.

events.title: Voyager 1 · Jupiter
events.detail: Discovered active volcanoes on Io, the first seen beyond Earth.

events.title: Voyager 2 · Jupiter
events.detail: Jupiter's gravity bends its path toward Saturn.

events.title: Voyager 1 · Saturn
events.detail: A close pass of Titan flings it up out of the planets' plane.

events.title: Voyager 2 · Saturn
events.detail: Saturn's gravity sends it on toward Uranus.

events.title: Voyager 2 · Uranus
events.detail: The only spacecraft ever to visit Uranus: 10 new moons found.

events.title: Voyager 2 · Neptune
events.detail: The only visit to Neptune: the Great Dark Spot and geysers on Triton.

events.title: Pale Blue Dot
events.detail: From 6 billion km, Voyager 1 turns around and photographs Earth.

events.title: Voyager 1 enters interstellar space
events.detail: Crosses the heliopause, the edge of the Sun's bubble of solar wind.

events.title: Voyager 2 enters interstellar space
events.detail: The second human-made object to leave the heliosphere.
